title: Anna's Archive has quietly begun releasing millions of music files from its scrape of Spotify, despite an injunction against distribution of copyrighted works (Ernesto Van der Sar/TorrentFreak)
summary: Ernesto Van der Sar / TorrentFreak: Anna's Archive has quietly begun releasing millions of music files from its scrape of Spotify, despite an injunction against distribution of copyrighted works — Anna's Archive is generally known as a meta-search engine for shadow libraries, helping users find pirated books and other related resources.
